scopeReview: CED FUN-6.D.1–2: substitution for indefinite and definite integrals, corresponding transformed bounds and differential factors. All logarithm and radical domains are checked; nested logs use x>1. Changed-bound signs are retained, including decreasing trigonometric substitution. No trigonometric-substitution method, integration by parts, partial fractions or improper integrals is assessed.
varietyReview: Power composite, radical cancellation, affine exponential, trig-over-denominator log, nested-log domain, squared-input cosine bounds, reciprocal quadratic log bounds, decreasing cosine substitution, radical-input exponential bounds, exponential inverse tangent and differential error analysis. Ten original-integrand/candidate-derivative corroborations supplement exact substitutions and derivative-back proofs.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
